blocks.heading: Biotechnology and Life Sciences (San Diego's Torrey Pines and Sorrento Mesa Clusters)
paragraphs: San Diego is home to one of the world's most productive biotech clusters — second only to the Bay Area in the US:

Illumina (San Diego HQ): The world's leading DNA sequencing company — Illumina's sequencing technology generates the world's largest genomics datasets. AI for Illumina's ecosystem: Variant calling and interpretation ML for next-generation sequencing data. Genomic data quality analytics for Illumina's instrument platforms. Liquid biopsy signal detection for early cancer detection from circulating tumor DNA.

Dexcom (San Diego HQ): The world's leading continuous glucose monitoring company — Dexcom's CGM sensors generate continuous glycemic data streams: Hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia prediction from CGM time-series data. Meal and activity impact modeling for personalized diabetes management. CGM sensor calibration ML for Dexcom's next-generation sensor platforms.
Additional San Diego biotech: Hologic (La Jolla), Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Halozyme Therapeutics, and dozens of San Diego biotechs.
Cost: $55,000–$165,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks

blocks.heading: Defense Technology (San Diego's Naval Complex)
paragraphs: San Diego is home to the largest naval base in the world — Naval Station San Diego — and the defense contractor ecosystem that supports it:
General Dynamics (San Diego operations) — submarine systems, defense electronics.
SAIC (Reston VA HQ but major San Diego presence) — defense IT and analytics.
Leidos (Reston VA HQ but large San Diego operations) — defense and intelligence analytics.
ClickMasters builds commercial AI for these companies' non-classified business operations.
Cost: $30,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 8–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Wireless and Semiconductor (Qualcomm's Innovation Ecosystem)
paragraphs: Qualcomm (San Diego HQ) is the world's leading mobile semiconductor and wireless technology company — the inventor of CDMA and a foundational force in 5G:
5G network optimization and quality prediction ML for Qualcomm's network technology programs.
Chipset testing analytics and quality prediction for Qualcomm's Snapdragon manufacturing.
Wireless signal processing ML for Qualcomm's modem and radio frequency technology.
Cost: $45,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare

Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

sections.title: San Diego's AI Investment Acceleration
sections.description: San Diego's commercial AI market is growing at an accelerating pace, driven by several converging forces.

blocks.heading: Torrey Pines Science Park expansion
paragraphs: San Diego's Torrey Pines Mesa — already home to Salk Institute, Scripps Research Institute, and UC San Diego's biology and bioengineering departments — is expanding with new biotech and life sciences facilities that are increasing the density of research AI demand.

blocks.heading: Qualcomm's AI chip initiatives
paragraphs: Qualcomm's Snapdragon platforms are increasingly AI-enabled — the Hexagon NPU (Neural Processing Unit) in every Snapdragon processor creates on-device AI inference capabilities that require the specific AI engineering expertise that Qualcomm's San Diego ecosystem concentrates.

blocks.heading: Navy and DARPA research spillover
paragraphs: San Diego's Naval facilities — Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command (SPAWAR), Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWAR) — fund defense AI research that increasingly commercializes through San Diego's technology transfer programs. The AI safety, autonomous systems, and sensor analytics research emerging from San Diego's naval research community creates commercial AI opportunities adjacent to defense.
